integrity: The fold-phase expansion and geometric ratio are proved analytically by the implicit function theorem and logarithmic asymptotics; no finite experiment is used to infer the limiting statement.
scientific_limitations: The result is conditional on a C2 first-order graph expansion and a simple fold for the leading same-chirality transition map. It proves the ratio for phase-locked fold returns, not for every heteroclinic-tangency sequence. A full-flow application requires verification that higher-order transition terms preserve the lifted phase asymptotic and that any tangency branch is phase-locked to the fold.
title: Geometric accumulation of fold-phase returns in a same-chirality Bykov transition map
